evals.prompt: Before I wire up a real MLIP I want a quick CPU sanity check that I can drive an equation-of-state workflow end to end with the ALCHEMI Toolkit. There is no GPU and no trained checkpoint here, so check it on CPU, but write it so it uses a GPU when one is there. Use the toolkit's Lennard-Jones model as a stand-in (epsilon = 0.5 eV, sigma = 2.1 angstrom, cutoff = 4.1 angstrom); I only care that the plumbing is right, not the numbers. Cap the optimizer at 50 steps per scan point and let it stop early on convergence with fmax = 0.05 eV/angstrom. Print the five relaxed energies and the fitted V0 and B0. When you are done, tell me the name of the script you wrote and which toolkit classes and functions it uses.
